objective: Improve classification generalization, specifically mitigating meningioma-pituitary and glioma-meningioma confusion, without degrading overall accuracy or overfitting.

data_configuration.official_test_set_status: LOCKED_AND_ISOLATED (dataset/Testing with 1,600 images will NOT be evaluated)

layer_unfreezing_plan.batch_normalization_policy: STRICTLY_FROZEN (all tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization layers kept trainable=False to protect batch statistics on CPU/small batches)

per_class_safeguards.diagnostic_target: Mitigate meningioma recall deficit (currently 63.80% due to 64 misclassified as pituitary) and glioma-meningioma confusion (29 misclassified)

acceptance_criteria.degradation_tolerance: Reject checkpoint if glioma recall falls below 0.8500 or validation macro-F1 degrades

crash_recovery_protocol.logging: Append epoch-level metrics and learning rates directly to history_csv after each epoch
crash_recovery_protocol.resumption_strategy: If process terminates prematurely, script can resume by loading the latest complete epoch checkpoint and adjusting initial_epoch parameter

methodological_caveats: Grouping by perceptual similarity (pHash threshold <= 4) mitigates exact and near-duplicate leakage across train and validation splits.
True patient-level independence CANNOT be claimed because patient IDs, clinical metadata, and DICOM headers are absent from the open-source dataset.
Official test set remains locked and unvisited until model architecture and training hyperparameters are completely frozen.
